xa: **Swachh Andhra** is one of the **10 Sutralu**; **500 ODF Plus villages** milestone.
**CLAP** handles door-to-door garbage collection.
**2029** is the house-site target, a trap.

168.s:
Which of the following statements is correct regarding recent sanitation-related developments in Andhra Pradesh?
1. Swachh Andhra is one of the 10 Sutralu.
2. A milestone of 500 ODF Plus villages was reported in January 2026.
3. CLAP was launched on 15 August 2025.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
168.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. CLAP was launched on 2 October 2021, not on 15 August 2025.
168.tq: Find the date-swapped false statement while retaining the two sanitation facts.
xs: Statements 1 and 2 are correct — option **(1) 1 and 2 only**.
Statement 1: **Swachh Andhra** is one of the **10 Sutralu**.
Statement 2: a **500 ODF Plus villages** milestone was reported in Jan **2026**.
Statement 3 is wrong: **CLAP** was launched on **2 Oct 2021** (Gandhi Jayanti); **15 Aug 2025** is **Stree Shakti**.
xa: CLAP results (2024-25): segregation **96.07%**; **6,890 tonnes/day** processed.
**104 STPs** (**690.90 MLD**); **171** under construction.
JJM: **70.04 lakh** households (**73%**) with taps; all by **2027**.

168.s: Which of the following statements regarding Village and Ward Secretariats in Andhra Pradesh is correct?
o: They were introduced in 2015, with 500 secretariats and 10 services.
They were introduced in 2001, with fewer than 100 secretariats and 50 services.
They were introduced in 2024, exclusively for urban taxation services.
They were introduced in 2019, with more than 10,000 secretariats and over 500 services.
168.x: Village and Ward Secretariats were introduced in 2019; the stated figures are more than 10,000 secretariats and over 500 services.
168.tq: Combine the year, institutional scale and service count without swapping the figures.
xs: **Village/Ward Secretariats** came in **2019** with **10,000+** secretariats and **500+ services** — option **(4)**.
**2001** is **e-Seva**, not the Secretariats.
xa: About **1 lakh** jobs; **1.68 crore** households mapped.
Renamed **Swarna Gramam and Swarna Ward**.
**GSWS (Amendment) Bill 2026** revises functionaries' roles.

168.s: The use of DBT through the JAM trinity is intended, among other things, to:
o: Increase the number of intermediaries in welfare distribution
Replace all welfare schemes with food coupons
168.x: Direct Benefit Transfer through the JAM trinity helps reduce ghost beneficiaries and middlemen in welfare delivery.
168.tq: Identify the governance problem addressed by the mechanism rather than its institutional abbreviation.
xs: **DBT** on the **JAM trinity** cuts **ghost beneficiaries and middlemen** — option **(2)**.
It does the opposite of adding intermediaries.
xa: Pensions use **Aadhaar biometric (ABBA)** authentication at the doorstep.
Criticism: **"new welfarism"** favours DBT and tangible transfers over public goods.
Kerala is moving pensions from doorstep delivery to **DBT**.

168.s: Which of the following correctly describes the relationship between Spandana and PGRS?
o: Spandana was a food subsidy and PGRS is a housing scheme
Spandana was a scholarship and PGRS is a health insurance programme
Spandana was the grievance portal and it is now referred to as PGRS
Spandana and PGRS are separate agricultural credit institutions
168.x: Spandana was the grievance portal, now referred to as PGRS. Faster grievance resolution was emphasised by the Chief Minister.
168.tq: Test the renamed-platform relationship instead of treating the two names as separate schemes.
xs: **Spandana** was the grievance portal, now called **PGRS** — option **(3)**.
The CM has pressed for **faster grievance resolution** under PGRS.
xa: Other renames: **Village/Ward Secretariats → Swarna Gramam and Swarna Ward**.
**Jagananna Amma Vodi → Talliki Vandanam**.
**Vahana Mitra → Auto Driver Sevalo ₹15,000**.

168.s: Under the Zero Poverty P4 approach, which redistribution relationship is proposed?
168.x: Zero Poverty P4 proposes that the top 10% support the bottom 20%.
168.tq: Avoid reversing the two population groups in a redistribution statement.
xs: Under **Zero Poverty P4**, the **top 10%** support the **bottom 20%** — option **(2)**.
Option (1) reverses it; option (3) swaps the percentages.
xa: **P4 phase 1**: **21.8 lakh** families.
Swarna Andhra @2047: end extreme poverty by **2030**.
Reported 12 Jun **2026**.

168.s: Which of the following correctly states the goals associated with Swarna Andhra @2047?
o: End extreme poverty by 2030 and become high-income by 2047
End extreme poverty by 2047 and become high-income by 2030
Achieve high income by 2030 and eliminate inequality by 2047
End poverty by 2026 and achieve high income by 2035
168.x: Swarna Andhra @2047 aims to end extreme poverty by 2030 and attain high-income status by 2047.
168.tq: Keep the earlier poverty target and later income target in sequence.
xs: **Swarna Andhra @2047**: end **extreme poverty by 2030** and become **high-income by 2047** — option **(1)**.
Option (2) swaps the two years.
xa: **Zero Poverty P4**: top **10%** support bottom **20%**.
**GSWS (Amendment) Bill 2026** aligns functionaries with Swarna Andhra 2047.
P4 phase 1: **21.8 lakh** families.

168.s: Which of the following was India’s first integrated citizen service-centre initiative?
168.x: e-Seva, introduced in 2001, was India’s first integrated citizen service-centre initiative.
168.tq: Apply the FIRST-in-sequence clue to distinguish an earlier service platform from later systems.
xs: **e-Seva (2001)** was **India's first integrated citizen service centres** — option **(3)**.
**MeeSeva** later became the single window; **e-Shram** is a national database of unorganised workers.
xa: Village/Ward Secretariats came in **2019**.
**GSWS (Amendment) Bill 2026** revises functionaries' roles.
**PGRS** handles grievances.

168.s: Which of the following best describes the criticism of “new welfarism”?
o: It favours direct benefit transfers and tangible transfers over public goods and may strain State finances.
It focuses exclusively on industrial subsidies rather than household benefits.
It prohibits the use of digital payments in welfare delivery.
It replaces all welfare schemes with public hospitals and schools.
168.x: The criticism is that new welfarism prioritises DBT and tangible transfers over public goods and places pressure on State finances.
168.tq: Distinguish the defining policy tendency from exaggerated or absolute alternatives.
xs: **"New welfarism"** favours **DBT and tangible transfers over public goods**, straining **State finances** — option **(1)**.
It is about household transfers, not industrial subsidies, and it does not ban digital payments.
xa: Fiscal strain from debt of about **36%** of GSDP.
Opposition: Super Six only **partly delivered**; pensions cut.
AP spends the most per head on social pensions (**16th FC**).

168.s: Which of the following correctly states the financial concern associated with Andhra Pradesh welfare commitments?
o: Debt is about 46% of GSDP, making all welfare delivery constitutionally impermissible.
Debt is about 36% of GSDP, contributing to concerns about fiscal strain.
Debt is about 16% of GSDP, with no concern about fiscal sustainability.
Debt is about 26% of GSDP and welfare spending has been eliminated.
168.x: The stated concern is fiscal strain arising in the context of debt of about 36% of GSDP.
168.tq: Select the precise fiscal figure while rejecting exaggerated percentage traps.
xs: Debt of about **36%** of GSDP drives concerns of **fiscal strain** — option **(2)**.
Welfare is neither unconstitutional nor eliminated.
xa: Criticism: **"new welfarism"** favours DBT over public goods.
Navaratnalu was funded from **revenue expenditure**.
Budget 2026-27: **₹27,719 crore** for NTR Bharosa.

169.s: Swarna Andhra@2047 is primarily intended to provide the framework for which of the following in Andhra Pradesh?
o: The reorganisation of districts completed in 2014
The privatisation of all public-sector undertakings
Only the state’s municipal reforms up to 2030
169.x: Swarna Andhra@2047 provides the framework for the 2024–29 policies and industrial corridors in Andhra Pradesh.
169.tq: Identify the precise scope of the vision instead of choosing an extreme or unrelated policy objective.
xs: **Swarna Andhra@2047** is the frame for the **2024-29 policies and industrial corridors** — option **(1)**.
It is a long-term vision, not a district reorganisation or privatisation plan.
xa: Energy goal: **net zero by 2047** (Integrated Clean Energy Policy).
**PanIIT Summit 2026** (Vijayawada, **3 Oct 2026**) drew a **DeepTech roadmap** for it.
The **"4.0" 2024-29** policy suite was notified on **26 Oct 2024**.

169.s:
With reference to the energy objective of Swarna Andhra@2047, consider the following statements:
1. Andhra Pradesh aims to achieve net zero emissions by 2047.
2. The objective is linked with the Integrated Clean Energy Policy and APSES 2024–25.
3. The target year for net zero is 2035.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
169.x: The net-zero target is 2047 and is associated with the Integrated Clean Energy Policy and APSES 2024–25. Statement 3 is false because the target year is not 2035.
169.tq: Split the statements by checking the target year and the policy association.
xs: Statements 1 and 2 are correct — option **(1) 1 and 2 only**.
Statement 1: AP aims at **net zero by 2047**.
Statement 2: the goal comes from the **Integrated Clean Energy Policy** (APSES **2024-25**).
Statement 3 is wrong: the target year is **2047**, not 2035.
xa: ⚠ **2047** = Swarna Andhra vision year = net zero target year.
Clean Energy Policy targets **160 GW** clean energy.
It aims to make AP a **global green hydrogen hub**.

169.s:
With reference to YSR Zero Interest Crop Loans, consider the following statements:
1. The scheme was launched on 20 April 2021.
2. Crop loans up to ₹1 lakh become interest-free when repaid on time.
3. The benefit is available only for loans exceeding ₹1 lakh.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
169.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because the scheme covers crop loans up to ₹1 lakh, subject to timely repayment.
169.tq: Find the wrong range statement by checking the upper limit and the word only.
xs: Statements 1 and 2 are correct — option **(1) 1 and 2 only**.
**YSR Zero Interest Crop Loans** launched **20 April 2021**.
Crop loans **up to ₹1 lakh** repaid on time become **interest-free** (**APPSC 2023**).
Statement 3 is wrong: the benefit is for loans up to ₹1 lakh, not above.
xa: **YSR Jala Kala** gives free borewells to small and marginal farmers.
**CCRC** gives tenant farmers access to loans, insurance and input subsidy.
**RBKs** (**2020**) are village one-stop centres.

169.s:
Consider the following pairs of Andhra Pradesh agriculture programmes:
1. YSR Jala Kala — Free borewells for small and marginal farmers
2. Rythu Bharosa Kendras — District-level offices only for sanctioning crop loans
3. e-Crop — Digital booking of the crop on every field each season
Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
169.x: Pairs 1 and 3 are correct: YSR Jala Kala gives free borewells to small and marginal farmers, and e-Crop digitally books the crop on every field each season (basis for insurance, input subsidy and procurement). Pair 2 is wrong: RBKs (2020) are village one-stop centres for seeds, fertilisers, advisory and procurement. So options containing 2 are wrong.
169.tq: RBK = village-level one-stop shop, not a district office.
xs: Pairs 1 and 3 are correct — option **(2) 1 and 3 only**.
**YSR Jala Kala** = free borewells for small and marginal farmers; **e-Crop** = digital booking of the crop on every field each season.
Pair 2 is wrong: **RBKs** (**2020**) are **village one-stop centres** for seeds, fertilisers, advisory and procurement.
xa: e-Crop is the basis for **insurance, input subsidy and procurement**.
**APCNF** is run by **Rythu Sadhikara Samstha** since **2016**.
**CCRC** under the **AP Crop Cultivators Rights Act, 2019**.

169.s: The Crop Cultivator Rights Card (CCRC) under the Andhra Pradesh Crop Cultivators Rights Act, 2019 is intended mainly to provide tenant farmers with:
o: Loans, insurance and input subsidy without affecting the owner's title
Ownership title over the leased land
169.x: The CCRC enables tenant farmers to access loans, insurance and input subsidy without touching the landowner's title.
169.tq: Separate the cultivator's access to benefits from ownership of the land.
xs: **CCRC** gives tenant farmers **loans, insurance and input subsidy without touching the owner's title** — option **(1)**.
So it confers no ownership title, tax exemption or land allotment.
xa: It is issued under the **AP Crop Cultivators Rights Act, 2019**.
AP's Rythu Bharosa also covered tenants.
**e-Crop** bookings underpin insurance and input subsidy.

169.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Its coverage increased along with the rise in extreme-weather crop losses.
2. The farmer premium is 2% for kharif crops, 1.5% for rabi crops and 5% for commercial and horticultural crops.
3. It has been voluntary for all farmers since Kharif 2020.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
169.x: All three statements are correct. PMFBY coverage in Andhra Pradesh rose with extreme-weather losses, and the specified farmer premium rates apply; the scheme has been voluntary for all farmers since Kharif 2020.
169.tq: Check each rate and the time qualifier before selecting the complete coded option.
xs: All three statements are correct — option **(4) 1, 2 and 3**.
PMFBY coverage in AP rose as **extreme-weather crop losses** rose (A and R both true, **APPSC 2023**).
Premium: **2% kharif, 1.5% rabi, 5% commercial/horticulture**.
**Voluntary for all farmers since Kharif 2020**.
xa: ⚠ Trap: CDX notes still say **"compulsory for loanee farmers"**.
PMFBY got **₹1,023 crore** in Budget 2024-25 BE.
**e-Crop** is the basis for insurance.

169.s: The suite of Andhra Pradesh policies designated as “4.0” for 2024–29 was notified on:
169.x: The listed 4.0 policies for 2024–29 were notified on 26 October 2024 and are valid for five years.
169.tq: Distinguish the common notification date from the separate startup-policy date and project-signing date.
xs: The **"4.0" 2024-29** policies were notified on **26 October 2024**, valid **5** years — option **(4)**.
**April 2025** is the **Innovation and Startup Policy** (ITE&C); **20 April 2021** is Zero Interest Crop Loans.
xa: G.O.s: **68** Industrial, **69** MSME, **70** Electronics, **71** Food Processing.
Industrial Development Policy 4.0 targets **₹30 lakh crore** investment.
MSME policy slogan: **"One Family, One Entrepreneur"**.

169.s:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (Policy)
a. Industrial Development Policy 4.0
b. MSME & Entrepreneur Development Policy 4.0
c. Food Processing Policy 4.0
d. Electronics Manufacturing Policy 4.0

List-II (Headline goal)
i. Production of USD 50 billion, investment of USD 10 billion and five lakh jobs
ii. One Family, One Entrepreneur and integration with global value chains
iii. Agricultural value addition, cold chains and mega food parks
iv. Promotion of sub-large to ultra-mega projects and an investment target of ₹30 lakh crore

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
169.x: The Industrial Development Policy targets large investment and higher project categories; the MSME policy carries the One Family, One Entrepreneur approach; the Food Processing Policy promotes value addition and cold chains; and the Electronics Manufacturing Policy has the stated production, investment and employment targets.
169.tq: Start with the distinctive slogan and numerical target, then eliminate the remaining codes.
xs: Correct match: **a-iv, b-ii, c-iii, d-i** — option **(1)**.
**Industrial Development** → sub-large to ultra-mega projects, **₹30 lakh crore**; **MSME** → **"One Family, One Entrepreneur"**.
**Food Processing** → value addition, cold chains, mega food parks; **Electronics** → **USD 50 bn** production, **USD 10 bn** investment, **5 lakh** jobs.
xa: All notified **26 Oct 2024**.
G.O.s: **68 – 69 – 70 – 71** = Industrial – MSME – Electronics – Food Processing.
Also in the suite: **Plug and Play** parks and **Sustainable Electric Mobility** policies.

169.s: Which of the following statements regarding project classifications under the Andhra Pradesh industrial policy framework is correct?
o: A large project is defined only by exports, while a mega project is defined only by land area.
A large project has fixed capital investment below ₹501 crore, while a mega project generates fewer than 2,000 direct jobs.
A large project has fixed capital investment above ₹501 crore and up to ₹1,000 crore, while a mega project generates 2,000 or more direct jobs.
A large project requires investment above ₹1,000 crore, while a mega project requires exactly 2,000 direct jobs.
169.x: A large project has fixed capital investment exceeding ₹501 crore and up to ₹1,000 crore. A mega project is associated with 2,000 or more direct jobs; mega and ultra-mega projects may receive case-by-case packages.
169.tq: Keep the investment threshold and employment threshold separate while rejecting reversed ranges.
xs: **Large** = fixed capital **>₹501 crore to ₹1,000 crore**; **Mega** = **2,000+ direct jobs** — option **(3)**.
⚠ Large is defined by **capital**; Mega by **jobs** — options (1), (2) and (4) distort this.
xa: **Mega/ultra-mega** projects get **case-by-case packages**.
Industrial Development Policy 4.0 covers **sub-large to ultra-mega** projects.
**SIPB** (chaired by the **CM**) approved **8** projects worth **₹2,45,275 crore** in 2024-25.

169.s: The Innovation and Startup Policy (4.0) of Andhra Pradesh for 2024–29 was issued by which department in April 2025?
169.x: The Innovation and Startup Policy (4.0), 2024–29, was issued in April 2025 by the ITE&C (Promotions) Department.
169.tq: Apply the 'which department issued the policy?' trap to distinguish the parent department from a specialised division.
xs: The **Innovation and Startup Policy (4.0) 2024-29** was issued in **April 2025** by the **ITE&C (Promotions) Department** — option **(4)** (**APPSC 2025**).
⚠ Not **Industries & Commerce**, and not dated **26 Oct 2024**.
xa: The Industries & Commerce suite (G.O.s **68-71**) was notified **26 Oct 2024**.
The **Integrated Clean Energy Policy** was launched in **June 2024**.
MSME slogan: **"One Family, One Entrepreneur"**.

169.s: Which of the following correctly describes the role of the Andhra Pradesh Industrial Infrastructure Corporation (APIIC)?
o: It regulates aquaculture farms, seed and feed throughout the State.
It functions exclusively as a foreign trade tribunal.
It administers only the State’s green-building certification system.
It is the nodal agency for industrial parks with plug-and-play facilities.
169.x: APIIC is the nodal agency for industrial parks and provides plug-and-play industrial infrastructure.
169.tq: Match the institution with its core administrative function.
xs: **APIIC** is the **nodal agency for industrial parks with plug-and-play facilities** — option **(4)**.
Aqua farms, seed and feed are regulated by the **Aqua Authority** (**2020** Act).
xa: Since **June 2026**, APIIC can allot up to **50 acres** directly without Cabinet approval.
**Single Desk Portal**: **99.2%** clearance.
**SIPB** is chaired by the **CM**.

169.s: Sri City, situated on the Andhra Pradesh–Tamil Nadu border, is best described as a:
o: Government-owned single-product port in Srikakulam district
Pharmaceutical research city in Anakapalli district
Greenfield international airport in Vizianagaram district
Private multi-product Special Economic Zone in Tirupati district
169.x: Sri City is a private multi-product SEZ located on the Andhra Pradesh–Tamil Nadu border in Tirupati district.
169.tq: Use the combination of ownership, product range, location and institutional type.
xs: **Sri City** is a **private multi-product SEZ** in **Tirupati district** on the AP-Tamil Nadu border — option **(4)**.
The pharma hub at **Anakapalli** is **JN Pharma City, Parawada**; **Mulapeta** port is in **Srikakulam**.
xa: ⚠ **Kopparthy** = Kadapa; **Kia** = Sri Sathya Sai; **Sri City** = Tirupati.
**Royal Enfield** is near **Tirupati** (Rayalaseema hub).
**Kurnool Ultra Mega Solar Park** is in Kurnool.

169.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with the Rayalaseema industrial hub initiatives?
169.x: Kia is associated with Sri Sathya Sai district. Royal Enfield is near Tirupati, JSW Steel is in Kadapa, and the AMCA integration and flight-test centre is another initiative of the hub.
169.tq: Test the institution-location relationship and reject swapped locations.
xs: **Kia — Sri Sathya Sai district** is correct — option **(3)**.
**JSW Steel** is at **Kadapa**; **Royal Enfield** is near **Tirupati**.
The **DRDO AMCA** integration and flight-test centre is in the **Rayalaseema hub**, not Machilipatnam.
xa: JSW Steel Phase-I: **₹4,500 crore** of **₹16,350 crore**.
**Space City** proposed near **Sriharikota**.
Significance: **Rayalaseema** turning from drought-prone to an **industrial hub**.

169.s: Kopparthy, in YSR Kadapa district, is associated with which of the following?
o: A multi-product SEZ on the Tamil Nadu border
A major fishing harbour and a biofuel park
An electronics manufacturing cluster and an NICP node
A greenfield international airport and an aqua authority
169.x: Kopparthy is associated with an electronics manufacturing cluster and an NICP node in YSR Kadapa district.
169.tq: Use the location-purpose pair to distinguish Kopparthy from Sri City and Bhogapuram.
xs: **Kopparthy** (YSR Kadapa) is an **electronics manufacturing cluster** and **NICP node** — option **(3)**.
The multi-product SEZ on the TN border is **Sri City**.
xa: AP's other NICP node: **Orvakal**.
Electronics Manufacturing Policy 4.0 targets **USD 50 bn** production.
**JSW Steel** is also in **Kadapa**.

169.s: Andhra Pradesh was ranked first in the Business Reforms Action Plan (BRAP) in which of the following years or combinations?
169.x: Andhra Pradesh ranked first in 2016 jointly with Telangana, and in 2017 and 2019. BRAP 2020 placed it among the Top Achievers.
169.tq: Track the exact sequence of years and the qualification attached to the 2016 ranking.
xs: AP was **first** in **BRAP 2016** (**joint with Telangana**), **2017** and **2019** — option **(1)**.
**BRAP 2020** placed AP among the **"Top Achievers"**.
xa: ⚠ CDI notes say "**#1 since 2016**".
**Single Desk Portal** clearance: **99.2%**.
Draft **Omnibus EoDB Act, 2026** cleared in Aug **2026**.

169.s: The State Investment Promotion Board (SIPB) of Andhra Pradesh is chaired by the:
169.x: The SIPB is chaired by the Chief Minister; in 2024-25 it approved 8 projects worth ₹2,45,275 crore with 65,541 jobs. The Chief Secretary, Industries Minister and Governor do not chair it.
169.tq: SIPB = CM's board.
xs: **SIPB** is chaired by the **Chief Minister** — option **(3)**.
In **2024-25** it approved **8** projects worth **₹2,45,275 crore** with **65,541** jobs.
xa: **APIIC** can allot up to **50 acres** without Cabinet approval.
**Mega** projects (**2,000+** jobs) get case-by-case packages.
**Real Time Governance** runs a command centre at the Secretariat.

169.s: BhuSeva is an integrated land-records platform that assigns each land parcel a unique:
169.x: BhuSeva assigns a unique Bhudhaar number to each land parcel as part of its integrated land-records system.
169.tq: Identify the exact official identifier associated with the land-records platform.
xs: **BhuSeva** gives each land parcel a unique **Bhudhaar** number — option **(2)**.
BhuSeva is AP's **integrated land-records platform**.
xa: ⚠ **MeeSeva** = service delivery; **BhuSeva** = land records.
**AP FiberNet (2017)** gives broadband, TV and telephone.
**RBKs** are village one-stop centres, not land IDs.

169.s: AP FiberNet, launched in 2017, was designed to provide which combination of services to homes and offices?
o: Only land registration and mutation services
169.x: AP FiberNet is a fibre grid launched in 2017 to provide low-cost broadband, television and telephone services to homes and offices.
169.tq: Select the complete service bundle linked to the fibre grid.
xs: **AP FiberNet (2017)** is a fibre grid for **low-cost broadband, TV and telephone** to homes and offices — option **(1)**.
Land records are **BhuSeva**; crop procurement runs via **RBKs** and **e-Crop**.
xa: **Real Time Governance (RTGS)** monitors services and grievances from the Secretariat.
**MeeSeva** is the single-window service platform.
**Single Desk Portal**: **99.2%** clearance.

169.s: A citizen grievance is being monitored continuously at a command centre located in the Secretariat. Which Andhra Pradesh system is being used?
169.x: Real Time Governance operates through a command centre at the Secretariat for real-time monitoring of services and grievances.
169.tq: Infer the institutional platform from the location and real-time monitoring function.
xs: **Real Time Governance (RTGS)** runs a **command centre at the Secretariat** monitoring services and grievances — option **(3)**.
**BhuSeva** = land records; **RBK** = village farm centre; **e-Crop** = crop booking.
xa: **AP FiberNet (2017)**: low-cost broadband, TV, telephone.
**MeeSeva**: single-window service delivery.
**SIPB** is chaired by the **CM**.

169.s: The Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority (APCRDA) functions under which legislation?
o: AP State Aquaculture Development Authority Act, 2020
169.x: APCRDA was established under the APCRDA Act, 2014. The AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 is relevant to Polavaram’s national-project status, not the constitution of APCRDA.
169.tq: Apply the wrong-Act trap by distinguishing similar year-and-subject legislation.
xs: **APCRDA** functions under the **APCRDA Act, 2014** — option **(3)**.
The **AP Reorganisation Act, 2014** (**S.90**) makes **Polavaram** a national project.
xa: ⚠ Two **2014** Acts: APCRDA Act (capital) and AP Reorganisation Act (Polavaram).
Amaravati foundation stone: **22 Oct 2015** by PM Modi.
Amaravati got **₹3,000 crore** in Budget 2024-25 BE.

169.s: Polavaram Project is located on the:
169.x: The Polavaram Project is located on the Godavari River.
169.tq: Use the river-project association rather than the district or funding details.
xs: **Polavaram** is on the **Godavari** — option **(4)**.
It is a **national project** under **S.90** of the **AP Reorganisation Act 2014**.
